map.📚 深度解析：净单保费（一次性缴清纯保费）: 📚 Deep Dive: Net Single Premium (Lump-Sum Pure Premium)

map.按本页死亡给付模型逐年递推：v=1÷1.03=0.970874；第 1 年死亡概: Under this page's death-benefit model, recursing year by year: v = 1÷1.03 = 0.970874. Year 1 death probability 1%, discounted payout 1,000,000×0.970874×1% = 9,708.74; year 2 survival 99%, death probability 0.99%, discounted payout 9,331.70; year 10 survival 91.35%, death probability 0.9135%, discounted payout 6,797.43. Summing the ten years gives NSP ≈ 81,763.70, i.e. 8.18% of the sum insured, while 90.44% of the cohort is still alive at the end of the term (no payout for them, so it is not counted in the net single premium). For comparison, a guaranteed 1,000,000 per year is an annuity-due with ä₁₀@3% ≈ 8.530 and a present value of about 8.53 million — that is a certain annuity without mortality, a different object from this page's death-benefit model, and the two cannot be swapped.
map.净单保费含费用吗？: Does the net single premium include expenses?
map.不含。它是纯风险现值，毛保费还要乘 (1+附加费率) 并考虑缴费方式。: No. It is the pure risk present value; the gross premium also multiplies by (1+loading rate) and considers the payment mode.
map.净单保费和趸缴保费差多少？: How much does the net single premium differ from the single premium?
map.净单保费等于纯风险现值，趸缴保费等于净单加费用附加（一次性）。健康体趸缴通常比分: The net single premium equals the pure-risk present value; the single premium equals net single plus expense loading (one-time). Healthy-life single premium is usually 15-30% above the installment net-single present value; the gap is expense and profit margin.
map.净趸缴保费（本页代码口径，逐年递推）：折现因子 v=1÷(1+年利率 i)；自生: Net single premium (code basis on this page, year-by-year recursion): discount factor v = 1÷(1+annual rate i); starting from survival probability sp = 1, for each year t = 1…n the recursion is: death probability that year = sp×q, NSP accumulates sum insured B×v^t×death probability that year, sp ×= (1−q); share of sum insured = NSP÷B×100 (%). Validation: all four fields are required through the input guard and must be valid numbers; additionally sum insured B > 0, annual mortality 0 ≤ q ≤ 1 (entered as a decimal: 1% = 0.01, out-of-range values make the yearly death probability negative or above 1), annual rate i > −1 (at i = −1 the factor v = 1÷(1+i) is infinite) and cover years a positive integer ≤ 1000 (beyond that it is capped at 1000 with a notice); otherwise it stops. Rule: no fixed grading; a higher interest rate lowers NSP and a higher mortality rate raises it. The result area also lists the year-by-year detail (opening survival probability, death probability that year, discount factor, discounted payout) and the survival probability at the end of the term, with separate notes for the zero-interest, q = 0 and q = 1 edges.
